From premise 2, we know that none of the ingredients of SILKY EYE PENCIL 13 are in 03 Bronzing Powder. Therefore, by process of elimination, all ingredients of SILKY EYE PENCIL 13 must be in Eye Restore.

The conclusion logically follows from the premises. If an ingredient is in SILKY EYE PENCIL 13, it must be in Eye Restore because it cannot be in 03 Bronzing Powder.
